title: AshokVillas
rera: Ashok Villas Imperial: PR1260002600608, Ashok Villas Grande: PR1260002600614
hero_caption: AshokVillas — 19 exclusive row villas, Ravet-Gahunje, Pune
tagline: Only 19 Exclusive Row Villas | Ultra-Limited Inventory | Ravet-Gahunje
overview: AshokVillas by Peninsula Land Limited is an ultra-limited collection of just 19 exclusive 3 BHK row villas near Ravet-Gahunje, directly connected to the Mumbai-Pune Expressway. Each G+1 villa offers 3,350 sqft of total usable area onwards, with a private front and back courtyard, a dedicated family den, a terrace yoga deck, and vastu-compliant layouts with a pooja area — select villas offer space for 2 car parks. Residents get access to the upcoming 15,000 sqft Club Peninsula, a private membership clubhouse with a swimming pool, gymnasium, badminton and paddle ball courts, and party lawn. Backed by Peninsula Land Limited, part of the Ashok Piramal Group, with 25+ years of real estate development across Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Nashik, Lonavala and Goa.
amenities: Open Air Party Lawn & Multi Court

title: Godrej River Royale
tagline: New Launch | 3 & 4.5 BHK Luxury Residences | Limited Inventory
overview: Godrej River Royale is a premium residential project by Godrej Properties located on the high-growth Baner–Hinjewadi corridor. Offering spacious 3 and 4.5 BHK apartments with panoramic views, world-class amenities and proximity to Pune's top IT hubs, it is designed for discerning homebuyers seeking luxury and convenience.

title: Kalpataru Aria
hero_caption: Kalpataru Aria — an 88-acre gated township, Karjat
tagline: 88-Acre Gated Township | Foothills of the Sahyadris | Karjat
overview: Kalpataru Aria is an 88-acre gated township at the foothills of the Sahyadris in Karjat, designed by Padma Bhushan architect Hafeez Contractor with landscaping by Green Space Alliance. The retreat-style address offers 2 BHK homes starting at ₹74.49 Lakhs, hill-view plots from 1,615 to 9,000 sqft starting at ₹88 Lakhs, and spacious 3 BHK luxury townhouses (1,700–1,800 sqft carpet) starting at ₹2.01 Cr. Residents get access to 30+ lifestyle amenities including a Grand Health Club, with excellent connectivity via the Mumbai–Pune Expressway, the upcoming Navi Mumbai International Airport, and Atal Setu — part of Karjat's fast-emerging Mumbai 3.0 growth corridor. Backed by Kalpataru's 53+ year legacy of over 110 landmark projects across Mumbai, Thane and Pune.
amenities: Grand Health Club with Swimming Pool

title: Kalpataru Blossoms
hero_caption: Kalpataru Blossoms — 3 towers on Sinhagad Road, Pune
tagline: 10:90 Subvention Scheme & Zero Stamp Duty | Sinhagad Road, Pune
overview: Kalpataru Blossoms is a 3-tower residential development on Sinhagad Road, Pune, offering spacious 2, 3, 3.5, 4 and 4.5 BHK homes designed by MQA Architects with landscaping by Vikas & Nilima Bhosekar. The location links seamlessly to Kothrud, Deccan and FC Road via Rajaram Bridge, with swift access to Laxmi Road, Swargate and the Mumbai-Bengaluru Highway via Navale Bridge. Residents get a central clubhouse with a swimming pool, spa, gymnasium, indoor preview theatre and co-working lounge, plus 35+ zoned outdoor amenities across activity, relaxation and fitness zones. Backed by Kalpataru's legacy of over 110 landmark projects and 120+ industry awards.
amenities: Spa with Salon, Steam Room & Jacuzzi
Multi-Purpose Sports Court & Cricket Practice Pitch

title: Shapoorji Pallonji Khopoli
hero_caption: Shapoorji Pallonji Khopoli — a 900-acre nature-led development in the Sahyadris
tagline: Pre-Launch Opportunity | ~900-Acre Nature-Led Development | Shapoorji Pallonji
overview: Presenting a landmark ~900-acre nature-led development near Khopoli, set amidst the scenic Sahyadri landscape. Premium residential plots from 1,700 to 6,000 sqft, low-density and nature-integrated by design, with over 2,000 acres of protected forest buffer surrounding the community. The masterplan includes private hamlets, row houses, wellness and sports zones, and a landmark 25,000 sq ft retreat centre anchored by a premium hospitality partner. Backed by the trusted legacy of Shapoorji Pallonji, and positioned in Khopoli — one of the Mumbai region's fastest-emerging infrastructure-led micro-markets.

title: Lodha Massimo
location: Pan Card Club Road, Baner Hills, Pune
tagline: Under Construction | Highest Point in Baner | Pan Card Club Road
overview: Lodha Massimo is a premium 3 & 4 BHK residential development by the Lodha Group, set at the highest point in Baner along Pan Card Club Road at the foothills of Baner Hill. The project is built around roughly 1,00,000 sq ft of central landscaped open space and offers a wide sports and leisure programme — a 25m lap pool, Sky Sports Club, multi-use courts, a padel court and 5-a-side football turf — alongside everyday conveniences like a café-cum-library and a dedicated pets' area. It sits close to Baner and Balewadi's IT parks (5–20 minutes), with malls, hospitals and schools nearby.

title: Mahindra Citadel
hero_caption: Mahindra Citadel — modern homes in Pimpri-Chinchwad
tagline: New Launch | 2 & 3 BHK Homes | EOI Now Open
overview: Mahindra Citadel is a residential project by Mahindra Lifespaces in Pimpri-Chinchwad, one of Pune's fastest-growing suburbs. Offering 2 and 3 BHK homes with modern amenities and strong connectivity to nearby industrial and IT hubs, the project is developed in phases under MahaRERA registration. Mahindra Lifespaces has delivered 8 completed projects and has 4 ongoing developments, backed by the Mahindra Group's real estate track record since 1994.

title: Mahindra Lifespaces Mahalunge
tagline: Coming Soon | 13.5-Acre Township | 6 Towers | Mahalunge, West Pune
overview: Mahindra Lifespaces presents its newest premium residential destination at Mahalunge, in the heart of Pune's first and largest Hi-Tech City Town Planning Scheme (TPS) — a 618+ acre planned development by PMRDA with a potential of 7 crore sq. ft., designed for 1.5 lakh+ residents and professionals within a 208-acre mixed-use township. Minutes from Hinjewadi, Baner and Balewadi, with connectivity via Metro, the Mumbai-Bengaluru Highway and the proposed Ring Road, Mahalunge has seen around 50% appreciation over the last four years. The 13.5-acre launch spans 6 towers and 1,240 premium residences, with a launch value of ₹1,500+ Crore.

title: Neoliv Grand Forest Privé
hero_caption: Neoliv Grand Forest Privé — site progress, Khopoli
tagline: Mumbai 3.0's Premium Forest Lifestyle Destination | Khopoli
overview: Neoliv Grand Forest Privé is a 9-acre low-density plotted development at the foothills of the Sahyadris in Khopoli, part of the Mumbai 3.0 growth corridor. Located near Radisson Hotel and Imagica Theme Park — just 7 minutes from the Mumbai–Pune Expressway and 45 minutes from Navi Mumbai International Airport — the project offers residential plots from 1,800 to 2,500 sqft with individual 7/12 ownership and Gr+2 construction allowed. Residents get access to two exclusive clubs, wide roads, and landscaped gardens, set against natural waterfalls and mountain views.

title: The Arena Pimpri
hero_caption: The Arena Pimpri — India's sports township concept, Pimpri, Pune
tagline: 80,000 Sq Ft Sports Township | Operated by Ileseum Sports Management | Pimpri
overview: The Arena Pimpri is a sports-first residential township in the heart of Pimpri, a joint venture between Mahalaxmi Group, Kohinoor Group and Agarwal Sukhwani Associates. Spacious 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes are built around 80,000 sq. ft. of dedicated sport and recreation — multi-sport courts, indoor racquet courts, a rooftop infinity pool, and a professionally run ecosystem operated by Ileseum Sports Management, drawing on their experience across 126 clubs. The location sits just 2 km from KWT (Kohinoor World Towers) and Pune Metro Line 1, with easy access to Chinchwad and Pimpri railway stations, Chakan MIDC, and Hinjewadi IT Park. Backed by Mahalaxmi Group's 25+ year legacy of 4.2 million sq. ft. delivered and 2,800+ delighted families.

title: Shapoorji Pallonji Treetopia
hero_caption: Treetopia — premium NA plots near Fort Jadhavgadh
tagline: New Plotted Development | RERA Approved | 483 Villa Plots
overview: Shapoorji Pallonji Treetopia is a premium plotted development spread across 105 acres in Jadhavwadi, Hadapsar–Saswad Road, East Pune. Developed by the 160-year-old Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate, it offers 483 NA villa plots ranging from 2,000 to 6,000 sqft with individual 7/12 extracts. The project features over 60% open green space, a 25-acre natural reservoir, and a luxury clubhouse set on a 3-acre parcel.
